name: Time With God
overview: Scripture reveals that God ordains the perfect timing for all things, placing eternity in the human heart beyond full comprehension, as seen in Ecclesiastes 3:11. Prioritizing time with God by seeking His kingdom and righteousness above all else ensures that our needs will be met, reflecting the promise in Matthew 6:33. Furthermore, James 4:8 encourages believers to draw near to God with sincere hearts, assuring that He will respond by drawing near to them, highlighting the intimate relationship cultivated through devoted time with Him.
